notes.title: Birthday sale again!!
notes.notes:
28/04 is the birthday of me, Takashi Yukihara. I wouldn't like to be celebrated it, but I felt like that I should do something nice, so I decided to have a one-day sale same as last year's one. The discount will be available from 0-24am JST.

[list]
[*]Living in Spring: 40% off
[*]Living in Spring - Full Size Event CG for digital wallpaper: 40% off
[*]Main Theme and Ending Music from “Living in Spring”: 40% off
[*]"Living in Spring" with broadcasting approval: 10% off (bundle, constantly)
[/list]
[i]Discount rate formula: (1.0-(1.0-0.4)×(1.0-0.1))×100=46%[/i]

This is the first 46% discount by now, and will be once a year with such as discount rate.
I hope you will pick them up.

notes.title: About reporting issues
notes.notes:
If you encounter any problems with "Living in Spring", you can report them here. (Another is on the official website of Yukihara Creation) 
I will check them every day until 03/13, and every Saturday thereafter.
And I will reply to messages written only in Japanese or English.

notes.title: Scheduled release date of “Living in Spring”
notes.notes:
Hello.
I am Takashi YUKIHARA, a director of “Living in Spring”.

Thank you for your interest in the game.
I announced that the release date is 02/29/2024 in the store page.
But there is no time information (cannot display it), so I announce the release time.

Release Date and Time: [b]02/29/2024 18:00 (JST)[/b]

It's also 02/29/2024 1:00 in PST.
Two DLC (digital wallpapers and soundtrack) will also be released on the same.
I wish you wait the day, quietly and in relax.


Takashi YUKIHARA
